# source.* ops

## `source.info`

Facts about the decoded source.

- Owner: CHB-006
- On: Image (camera-linear) → Value
- Class: measure; binding: scan
- Implementation: mock

Returns:

- `width`: number (px) — width in source pixels
- `height`: number (px) — height in source pixels
- `bits`: number (none) — bits per sample
- `encoding`: string — transfer encoding
- `sha256`: string — source identity

## `source.open`

Opens a decoded source as linear sensor values (T = signal / flat after scan.flatField), with its pitch on the film.

- Owner: CHB-006
- On: none (—) → Image (camera-linear)
- Class: global; binding: scan
- Implementation: mock
- See: `source.info`, `scan.flatField`

| Argument | Type | Unit | Range | Usual | Default | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string |  |  |  |  | SHA-256 of the source file (Document.source.sha256); the engine must have opened it. |
| `encoding` | enum linear/srgb/gamma22 |  |  |  | `"linear"` | Transfer encoding of the stored samples (Document.source.decode.encoding). |
| `umPerPx` | number | um | [0.01, 100000] |  |  | Film µm per document pixel: the scan medium's umPerPx, or a camera file's film format over its long side. Sets ImageInfo.umPerPx.film, which every physical size (µm on the film, mm on the print) is converted with. |

## `source.xyz`

Photo mode: camera RGB to white-balanced scene XYZ: the camera matrix (SourceInfo.camera), then the CAT16 adaptation from the white of the temperature and tint to D65 (contract white-balance.ts sceneMatrix).

- Owner: CHB-006
- On: Image (camera-linear) → Image (scene-xyz)
- Class: pointwise; binding: scan
- Implementation: mock
- See: `capture.expose`

| Argument | Type | Unit | Range | Usual | Default | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `temperature_K` | number | K | [2000, 50000] | [2500, 10000] | `6502.073737141535` | White balance: the temperature of the light the scene was lit by (Lightroom's Temperature; higher makes the picture warmer). Default: no correction (D65). |
| `tint` | number | none | [-150, 150] | [-50, 50] | `9.766663536235953` | White balance: the light's tint, green (−) to magenta (+) correction, in Lightroom's units (Adobe's: 1 = 1/3000 of a CIE 1960 uv unit across the isotemperature line). |
